$schema: StyloDyna Design Reference Governance Schema v1.0

governance.rule: Authoritative design reference files are strictly human-approved, read-only artifacts. Antigravity must never overwrite, recompress, convert, rename, replace from .user_uploaded, or automatically update manifest SHA-256 hashes for reference files.
governance.versioningRule: If a reference update is explicitly approved by the human operator, create a new versioned file (e.g. whatsapp-hover-panel-ui-reference-v2.png) and register it in this manifest.
